plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-16 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/, reached from the college's official program-mapper page; no login required or attempted). The map is headed 'Transfer Pathway map for 2026-2027' and the pathway is for catalog year 2026-2027. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. Card View and Table View agreed exactly on every row. The inventoried program 'Administration of Justice' is listed in the mapper under the name 'Administration of Justice'; the program details state the student will be awarded an Associate in Science for Transfer (AS-T) degree in Administration of Justice. The mapper lists two 2026-2027 pathways for this credential. This plan transcribes the Bakersfield College segment of the first-listed pathway, 'Bakersfield College / Administration of Justice / Associate in Science for Transfer / 60-64 units / 4 terms / to CSU Bakersfield', in full. That pathway continues into a CSU Bakersfield segment (Criminal Justice, Bachelor of Arts, 60 units, 4 terms); that segment is a different institution's degree, is not part of this Bakersfield College plan, and was not transcribed. The second 2026-2027 pathway ('to California State University') has a Bakersfield College segment identical to the one transcribed here and no CSU course segment; it is not collected as a separate plan. In 2025-2026 only the CSU Bakersfield pathway existed, at the same totals (Bakersfield 60-64 units) but in 6 terms (a leading milestone-only term and a trailing milestone-only term around the same four content terms, identical row for row). The transcribed map prints the degree total as a range, 60-64 units, and term totals as 15-16.5 / 15-17.5 / 15 / 15. Ranged rows: Term 1 'Area 1A : English Composition' (3-4.5); Term 2 'Area 1B : Critical Thinking and Composition' (3-4) and 'Area 2 : Mathematical Concepts and Quantitative Reasoning' (3-4.5). Per the standing minimum-credit convention every ranged row is recorded at its printed minimum, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum and the plan total is the printed minimum of 60 units. The 'Major List A' slot is printed twice in Term 2 and the 'Major List B' and 'Area 4 : Social and Behavioral Sciences' slots are each printed in two different terms; each occurrence is recorded as a separate choice slot exactly as printed. No row in the Bakersfield College segment shows a 'Prerequisites', 'Corequisites' or 'Dual Enrollment' flag in Card View, so no prereqs are recorded. General-education, major-list and elective slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not enumerated. Milestone rows printed on the map carry no course content and are not encoded. No separate Certificate program named Administration of Justice exists in the mapper. The map page states verbatim: 'This program map represents one possible pathway through the program and may not reflect the most current catalog requirements. Make an appointment to create a customized education plan that fits your needs.'
